ui_bugs.issue: Task 7 NOT achieved: guest visiting /book/{id}?pkg=..&city=..&date=.. is redirected to plain '/login' with NO ?next=. Root cause — <Protected> (App.js:40-46) renders <Navigate to="/login" replace/> before BookingFlow ever mounts, so the iter73 `nav(`/login?next=...`)` code inside BookingFlow.jsx (line ~112) is dead/unreachable. Verified: /login?next=<encoded full path> works end-to-end when hit directly (returns to /book/..?pkg&city&date, restores step + prefilled date/city), so the only fix needed is `<Navigate to={`/login?next=${encodeURIComponent(location.pathname+location.search)}`} replace/>` in Protected.

Wizard steps do not push history entries, so browser Back from step 3 exits the booking flow entirely (landed back on /login) instead of going to step 2 as the spec expects. sessionStorage state is preserved and the in-app '← Back' button works correctly, so data is not lost — but the requested browser-Back behaviour is unmet.
An already-logged-in user who lands on /login sees the full sign-in form instead of being redirected to their dashboard (observed after browser Back from booking flow while authenticated).

issues: React console error on every load: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>. This will cause a hydration error.' — a <span> is nested inside an <option> (package/city select). Should be moved out of the option element.

action_items: App.js: make <Protected> append ?next=<encodeURIComponent(pathname+search)> when redirecting to /login (this is the only blocker for iter73 item 7).
Optional: push each BookingFlow step to history (or intercept popstate) so browser Back steps backwards inside the flow instead of leaving it.
Redirect authenticated users away from /login (or to resolveDest) instead of rendering the sign-in form.
Fix <span> inside <option> hydration warning on ArtistProfile.
critical_code_review_comments: BookingFlow.jsx:107-113 guest-redirect block is unreachable because the route is already wrapped in <Protected>; either remove it or move the next-param logic into Protected.

BookingFlow restores step from sessionStorage unconditionally — a stale state for the same artist will drop a user mid-funnel on a fresh booking link; consider expiring the stash (timestamp) or clearing when URL params differ.

QuestionnaireWizard deep-link effect keys off the startSection value only, so re-clicking the SAME sidebar section after manually paging within the wizard will not re-jump (no state change). Use a nonce/counter alongside the section name.
ArtistDashboard.jsx is very large (>2400 lines) — MediaManager/Availability/Questionnaire sub-managers should be split into separate modules.
